profile: Pyzzel create_many PostgreSQL vs client analysis

method_notes.explain: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the INSERT inside an explicit transaction that is rolled back. Its server Execution Time excludes normal transmission of all RETURNING rows and includes EXPLAIN instrumentation overhead.
method_notes.execute: Psycopg conn.execute duration includes client parameter adaptation, query protocol, PostgreSQL work, and response reception; not pure server time.
method_notes.values_control: Sends the same bind values but executes a read-only VALUES/count query; diagnostic only.
method_notes.roundtrip_baseline: SELECT 1 establishes a small-query round-trip baseline; it is not a pure network measurement.
method_notes.chunking: Only test-profile statement boundaries vary; transaction, data, schema, RETURNING ids, and generated-ID checks remain the same.

psycopg_parameter_adaptation.note: Psycopg Transformer serialization only; excludes SQL placeholder processing, socket transfer, PostgreSQL, and result handling.

values_transport_control.note: Control sends the same values and parameter count but constructs/scans VALUES and returns one aggregate row; it is diagnostic, not equivalent INSERT work.

values_control_explain_analyze.note: EXPLAIN ANALYZE planning/execution for the VALUES control only; includes query parsing costs outside the reported Planning Time only in the client wall time, and uses EXPLAIN instrumentation.
